query:
SELECT DISTINCT r AS "repo!"
               FROM github_installations, unnest(repositories) AS r
               WHERE NOT removed AND NOT suspended
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM repos
                     WHERE right(lower(regexp_replace(url, '(\.git)?/*$', '')), length(r) + 1) = '/' || r)
               ORDER BY 1
               LIMIT 500
